text:
oliver: heads-up — saw a weird edgecase with streaming responses + redaction in the node sampleapp. on retry the later streaming chunks have spans without request_id (looks redacted) even though the initial chunk/span had the id
mei: can you paste the middleware/order and a tiny repro?
oliver: minimal ordering in server.js:
```js
app.use(otel.init())
app.use(streamingHandler) // breaks response into chunks and writes partial spans
app.use(retryMiddleware)   // library can replay requests and retries after partial write
app.use(redactMiddleware)  // scrubs headers before final write
```
oliver: symptom: first chunk logs/span -> request_id=live-42; retry happens mid-stream -> subsequent chunk spans show request_id=<redacted> or missing; OTLP collector shows a mix of raw and redacted attrs for same trace
devon: ah i think two things collide: (1) streaming handler flushes partial span data which triggers exporter to snapshot context early, (2) retry mutates headers for replay and redact runs after, so some exported spans pick up mutated headers at export-time.
mei: interesting. i hadn't considered mid-stream retries. did you trigger a retry because of a downstream 5xx after first chunk?
oliver: yes — external service errored after chunk 1 so retry replayed request; our retry lib reuses the same header object for replay and redact runs later in middleware chain
devon: mitigation ideas: a) for streaming endpoints, snapshot request_id into an immutable span attribute as soon as request starts (e.g., span.setAttribute('redwood.request_id.snapshot', val)) so chunked exports always have the original; b) make redaction wire-only and run it just before socket write (avoid mutating span context); c) ensure retry middleware clones headers instead of mutating in-place
mei: i vote for (a) + (c) as pragmatic for sampleapps. also add an exporter-side scrubber that ensures no raw ids are sent for public builds.
oliver: wrote a tiny poc that snapshots on start and added a test that simulates mid-stream retry; passes locally. PR WIP: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/8137 (prototype)
devon: filed a short issue DEVEX-5432 to track exporter-scrubber & streaming e2e test — https://issuetracker.internal/DEVEX-5432
mei: docs note: update devex/telemetry "hook ordering" doc with a short section about streaming endpoints + retry interactions and include recommended patterns per SDK (node/java/python/go)
oliver: action items: oliver -> finish PR + tests; mei -> docs update; devon -> exporter scrubber spike and e2e harness for streaming. tagging @devex for visibility. :eyes: 
telemetry-bot: New issue opened: DEVEX-5432 "streaming endpoints: request_id lost/mixed on retries when redaction runs after retry" — https://issuetracker.internal/DEVEX-5432
